name: browser-use
headline: agent-skills-generator for documentation
short_description: Agent Skills Generator creates AI agent skills from website documentation. Operations teams use it to convert documentation into Markdown skills for AI agents and LLMs. It includes a VS Code extension and Go CLI for easy integration into existing workflows.
author: rodydavis

sections.overview:
Agent Skills Generator transforms documentation websites into structured Markdown skills ready for AI agents and language models. It offers two interfaces: a VS Code extension with visual rule management and one-click generation, and a high-performance Go CLI for recursive crawling with HTML-to-Markdown conversion. The tool extracts metadata, supports configurable crawling depth and filtering, and stores output in flat structures compatible with RAG systems. Operations teams use it to automate skill creation from existing documentation, reducing manual conversion time and ensuring consistent formatting for AI agent consumption.
Convert API documentation into skills for Claude Code agents
Automatically generate LLM-ready Markdown from technical documentation sites
Build skill libraries for internal tools and frameworks
Create RAG-compatible documentation sets for AI training
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/rodydavis/agent-skills-generator`
sections.usage:
```
Convert the documentation from [WEBSITE_URL] into a structured AI agent skill in Markdown format. Follow the format: **Skill Name**: [NAME], **Description**: [ONE_SENTENCE_SUMMARY], **Input Parameters**: [LIST], **Output Format**: [STRUCTURE], **Example Usage**: [CODE_BLOCK]. Ensure the skill is executable by an AI agent and includes error handling for common edge cases.
```
Copy

```
```markdown
**Skill Name**: GitHub Repository Cloner
**Description**: Clones a GitHub repository to the local filesystem with branch selection and error handling.

**Input Parameters**:
- `repo_url` (string): Full URL of the GitHub repository (e.g., `https://github.com/owner/repo.git`).
- `branch` (string, optional): Branch name to clone. Defaults to `main`.
- `target_dir` (string, optional): Local directory path. Defaults to `./repo`.

**Output Format**:
```json
{
  "success": boolean,
  "message": string,
  "repo_path": string,
  "error": string (if applicable)
}
```

**Example Usage**:
```bash
# Clone the 'dev' branch of 'my-project' to './my-project'
skill github-repo-cloner --repo_url "https://github.com/acme/my-project.git" --branch "dev" --target_dir "./my-project"
```

**Error Handling**:
- Invalid repository URL: Returns `{"success": false, "message": "Invalid repository URL", "error": "404 Not Found"}`.
- Branch not found: Returns `{"success": false, "message": "Branch 'feature-x' not found", "error": "BranchNotFound"}`.
- Permission denied: Returns `{"success": false, "message": "Git authentication failed", "error": "PermissionDenied"}`.
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
